# Code of Conduct

This project follows the Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct, version 2.1.

- Home: https://www.contributor-covenant.org
- Version: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported to the maintainers via issues or security contact listed in SECURITY.md.
